verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.Hear my cry, O God;attend to my prayer.
verses.heading: You Have Heard My Vows

verses.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to Youwhenever my heart is faint.Lead me to the rockthat is higher than I.
For You have been my refuge,a tower of strength against the enemy.
Let me dwell in Your tent foreverand take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.Selah
For You have heard my vows, O God;You have given me the inheritancereserved for those who fear Your name.
Increase the days of the king’s life;may his years span many generations.
May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever;appoint Your loving devotionand Your faithfulness to guard him.
Then I will ever sing praise to Your nameand fulfill my vows day by day.
